notes: Rendering required a compatibility mapping because truckscenes-devkit 1.2.0 expects matplotlib.cm.get_cmap and Matplotlib 3.11.1 exposes the replacement through matplotlib.colormaps.get_cmap. The committed script applies this mapping narrowly. Orange boxes are dataset ground truth, not model predictions.
